title_zh: 选择先观看武术慢动作示范

scenario.label_zh: 询问武术体验并选择先观察
scenario.goal_zh: 了解体验课可先旁观，约定观看慢动作示范后再决定是否参加练习

context_zh: 社区武术体验课接待处，新来者林向教练马克询问参与方式。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: I've never tried a martial art. Do beginners have to practise with a partner straight away?

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.text: Not in this session. You can watch the opening demonstration before deciding to join in.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: The movements looked too fast in the video.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.text: We'll show the first sequence in slow motion and explain where each movement begins and ends.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Could I sit near the front and just watch that part?

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.text: Certainly. Take the chair by the entrance, and let me know afterwards whether you'd like to try the introductory exercise.

sentences.speaker: Lin
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll watch the demonstration first and decide then.
